emma_s: Hey team — Lumina Health is asking us to run a throughput / smoke POC before the contract call. Their ask: steady 750 rps (requests/sec) with 512 token average responses, and short 2k rps bursts for up to 90s. They want: runbook, example load commands, a quick cost delta between hosted vs committed, and a note on KMS/HSM latency. Can we lock this down for Tuesday?
raj_solutions: I can drive the runbook. Suggest: 15m ramp to 750rps, 30m steady, then 3 x 90s bursts at 2krps spaced 10m apart, and 10m cool-down. Capture p50/p95/p99 tail latency, error rate, and token cost breakdown. OK?
mike_eng: Sounds reasonable. A few notes:
- For 512 tokens avg per request, token throughput = rps * tokens (big). At 750rps that's ~384k tokens/sec — this requires batching + multiple pods/GPUs or use of larger gen instances.
- Recommend using the hosted model alias `rwd-70b-quant` (our quantized variant) for cost; it has slightly higher p99 on cold-starts but stable in steady-state.
- Disable aggressive request-level batching so application-level concurrency maps better to their client pattern; use server-side continuous batching only.

mike_eng: Example Vegeta command we usually run (put targets file with a single POST that streams):
```
vegeta attack -duration=00m45s -rate=750 -targets=lumina_targets.txt | vegeta report -type=json > lumina_results.json
```
Add a second run with rate=2000 for the bursts and a third run with a ramp profile (we have small python harness if you prefer).

mike_eng: Also add `X-Model-Variant: rwd-70b-quant` header, and set `stream=true` in the payload to measure streaming latency. Capture CPU/GPU metrics per pod (nvprof or nvidia-smi sampling every 5s) and our console token counters.
alice_sec: On KMS/HSM: using standard KMS for envelope keys is fine and will not materially affect per-request latency (few ms for the initial key unwrap). If Lumina requires FIPS/HSM, that's an enterprise/private deployment and we need a separate ticket + contract addendum. Also request: they asked for encryption-in-transit/at-rest confirmation and an audit CSV — I can prepare the checklist.
luke_prodops: For pricing: rough back-of-envelope for this workload — hosted on pay-as-you-go with rwd-70b-quant will be dominated by token cost. If they expect sustained 750rps x 512 tokens x 30m steady per day, that's ~7.4B tokens/day (huge). Recommend we present two options:
1) Hosted consumption: per-token pricing estimate + throttling advice. (good for PoC only)
2) Dedicated reserved capacity: price estimate ~ $Xk/month for a pool sized for sustained 750rps with burst headroom. I'll pull the committed sizing numbers after we choose instance type. (will send a spreadsheet)

emma_s: Luke — can you give a ballpark number before the Tuesday sync so AE has something in the slide deck? Even a range is fine.

luke_prodops: Ballpark: dedicated pool to sustain 750rps @512 tokens with reasonable tail = around 6-12 GPUs depending on instance family and batching. Monthly reserved commitment in the ballpark of $40k-$90k/mo. I'll refine once mike confirms model perf numbers.

sre-bot: deploy: rwd-70b-quant (us-west-2) successfully deployed to staging (build 2026.03.21-78) :white_check_mark:

mike_eng: Quick perf callouts from our last internal run on p4d: p50 request latency (stream start) ~ 110ms at 256 tokens when batched; extrapolating to 512 tokens and larger concurrency expect p50 ~ 180-240ms, p95 ~ 600ms, p99 could spike -> we need to monitor KV cache warmness. These are rough; I'll run a focused calibration on Friday.

raj_solutions: Runbook checklist (I'll own execution):
- Prep: create targets file, auth token for lumina test client, and environment variables for metrics export.
- Warmup: 10m low traffic (100rps) to populate caches.
- Ramp: 15m ramp to 750rps.
- Steady: 30m capture.
- Bursts: 3x 90s at 2krps.
- Data collection: latency buckets, error logs, token emission metrics, pod-level GPU util, and console billing samples.
- Post-run: collect vegeta JSON, grafana screenshots, and a short writeup with recommendations.

emma_s: Great. Action items: Raj runs tests Mon 10:00 PST; Mike to run calibration Fri and share perf numbers + exact GPU counts; Luke to send rough pricing before Tue morning; Alice to prepare KMS/audit CSV.

mike_eng: I'll also include a tiny script to synthesize variable prompt lengths so we don't accidentally overfit to 512-token single-case. Will post link to harness in the thread.

emma_s: Thanks — LMK if you need AE in the call. I'll update Lumina with the tentative schedule.

raj_solutions: Copy. Scheduling the run and will post final runbook + vegeta targets in #sales before Monday.

luke_prodops: Sending initial estimate spreadsheet to this thread in a bit. :mag: 

alice_sec: I'll attach the checklist and the quick KMS note by EOD Friday.

emma_s: Awesome. :thumbsup:
